from: I liked the report that you sent last week.
frame: I liked the report ___ last week.

ok.de: Richtig: the report you sent last week. Das Pronomen that ist Objekt und darf fehlen.
ok.en: Right: the report you sent last week. The pronoun that is the object and may be dropped.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort sent muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word sent must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort sent muss in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word sent must be in the gap.

from: This is the best offer which we have received so far.
frame: This is the ___ we have received so far.

ok.de: Richtig: the best offer we have received so far. Nach dem Superlativ darf das Pronomen fehlen.
ok.en: Right: the best offer we have received so far. After the superlative the pronoun may be dropped.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort best muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word best must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort best gehört vor offer.
wrong.en: The key word best belongs before offer.

from: The staff who are working on the audit meet every Friday.
frame: The ___ the audit meet every Friday.

ok.de: Richtig: The staff working on the audit. Das aktive Partizip ersetzt who are working.
ok.en: Right: The staff working on the audit. The active participle replaces who are working.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort working muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word working must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach working braucht es on: working on the audit.
wrong.en: After working you need on: working on the audit.

ok.en: Right: All questions raised in the meeting. The passive participle replaces that were raised.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort raised muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word raised must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Das Nomen questions steht vor dem Partizip.
wrong.en: The noun questions stands before the participle.

ok.de: Richtig: The decision of the manager surprised everyone. Of ersetzt das ’s.

wrong.en: The key word of must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.en: The key word of must come before the manager.

ok.de: Richtig: The CEO of the company resigned yesterday. Of ersetzt das ’s.
ok.en: Right: The CEO of the company resigned yesterday. Of replaces the ’s.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort of muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word of must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort of muss vor the company stehen.
wrong.en: The key word of must come before the company.

from: Our CFO was the first person who read the report.
frame: Our CFO was the ___ the report.

ok.en: Right: the first person to read the report. After first the to-infinitive follows.

wrong.en: The key word first must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach first person steht to + Grundform: to read.
wrong.en: After first person comes to + base form: to read.

from: This is the best way of reducing costs.

wrong.de: Nach way steht to + Grundform: to reduce.

prompt: That was the best presentation what I have seen.
fixed: That was the best presentation I have seen.

ok.de: Der Fehler: what ist kein Relativpronomen nach einem Nomen. Richtig: the best presentation I have seen.
ok.en: The error: what is not a relative pronoun after a noun. Correct: the best presentation I have seen.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach dem Nomen steht that oder nichts, nie what.
wrong.en: There is an error: After the noun comes that or nothing, never what.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt woanders: Nach dem Nomen steht that oder nichts, nie what.
wrong.en: The error is elsewhere: After the noun comes that or nothing, never what.

prompt: The report that you sent it was very helpful.
fixed: The report that you sent was very helpful.

ok.de: Der Fehler: das it ist doppelt, denn that ist schon das Objekt. Richtig: the report that you sent.
ok.en: The error: it is doubled, because that is already the object. Correct: the report that you sent.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Das Objekt steht nur einmal, entweder als that oder gar nicht.
wrong.en: There is an error: The object appears only once, either as that or not at all.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt woanders: Das Objekt steht nur einmal, entweder als that oder gar nicht.
wrong.en: The error is elsewhere: The object appears only once, either as that or not at all.

prompt: All the files storing in the cloud are encrypted.
fixed: All the files stored in the cloud are encrypted.

ok.de: Der Fehler: die Dateien werden gespeichert, also die 3. Form stored.
ok.en: The error: the files are stored, so the past participle stored.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Passive Bedeutung braucht die 3. Form.
wrong.en: There is an error: Passive meaning needs the past participle.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt woanders: Passive Bedeutung braucht die 3. Form.
wrong.en: The error is elsewhere: Passive meaning needs the past participle.

prompt: All requests related to the new tool must go through the help desk.

ok.en: Right: All requests related to the new tool. The participle related replaces that are related.

wrong.de: Hier ist alles richtig: All requests related to ist richtig gebildet.
wrong.en: Everything is right here: All requests related to is correctly formed.

prompt: The managers decision surprised the whole team.
fixed: The manager's decision surprised the whole team.

ok.de: Der Fehler: der Besitz braucht den Apostroph. Richtig: the manager’s decision.

wrong.en: There is an error: Possession takes an apostrophe and s.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt woanders: Der Besitz steht mit Apostroph und s.
wrong.en: The error is elsewhere: Possession takes an apostrophe and s.

ok.de: Der Fehler: zwischen Firma und CEO fehlt das ’s. Richtig: the company’s CEO.

wrong.en: There is an error: The owner needs ’s.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt woanders: Der Besitzer braucht ’s.
wrong.en: The error is elsewhere: The owner needs ’s.

prompt: We need someone lead the migration.
fixed: We need someone to lead the migration.

a: This is the best offer we have received.
b: This is the best offer that we have received.

q.en: Do both sentences mean the same?

ok.de: Richtig: beide. Das that darf nach dem Superlativ fehlen.
ok.en: Right: both. The that may be dropped after the superlative.

wrong.de: Nicht nur a: b sagt mit that dasselbe.
wrong.en: Not only a: b says the same with that.

wrong.de: Nicht nur b: a sagt ohne that dasselbe.
wrong.en: Not only b: a says the same without that.

a: The manager criticizing the plan left.
b: The manager criticized by the board left.

q.de: Welcher Satz sagt, dass der Manager kritisiert wurde?
q.en: Which sentence says that the manager was criticized?

ok.de: Richtig: Satz b. Die 3. Form criticized hat passive Bedeutung.
ok.en: Right: sentence b. The past participle criticized has passive meaning.

wrong.de: In a kritisiert der Manager den Plan. Das ist aktiv.
wrong.en: In a the manager criticizes the plan. That is active.

wrong.de: Aktiv und passiv sind verschieden.
wrong.en: Active and passive are different.

q.de: Welcher Ausdruck meint die Entscheidung mehrerer Manager?
q.en: Which expression means the decision of several managers?

ok.de: Richtig: b. Managers im Plural mit of meint mehrere Personen.
ok.en: Right: b. Managers in the plural with of means several people.

wrong.de: In a steht manager im Singular: eine Person.
wrong.en: In a manager is singular: one person.

wrong.de: Singular und Plural sind verschieden.
wrong.en: Singular and plural are different.

a: She was the first customer to sign.
b: She was the first customer who signed.

q.en: Do both sentences mean the same?

ok.de: Richtig: beide. To sign ersetzt who signed, nur knapper.
ok.en: Right: both. To sign replaces who signed, just shorter.

wrong.de: Nicht nur a: b sagt dasselbe mit einem Relativsatz.
wrong.en: Not only a: b says the same with a relative clause.

wrong.de: Nicht nur b: a sagt dasselbe kürzer.
wrong.en: Not only b: a says the same more briefly.
